description: This file is a language resource file for SuiteCRM (which is based on SugarCRM). It contains an array of localization strings ($mod_strings) used for UI labels, help texts, and interface components in the ModuleBuilder's English (US) language pack. Additionally, it includes license information, security checks, and various UI labels for the developer tools, module management, layout editing, relationships, dropdowns, and other Studio functionalities.
